detail.longDescription:
Your "read-only" Grafana AI agent might not be: mcp-grafana ships write tools ON by default.

Fix: Viewer service account + --disable-incident --disable-oncall --disable-sift --disable-annotations.

Full setup:
https://devtocash.com/blog/2026-09-07-grafana-mcp-server-ai-agents-safe-setup
